formal_living_dining.designBrief: Clean lines, simple furniture, neutral colours and limited decoration create calm, uncluttered formal living and dining spaces. The design prioritises comfort, functionality and a clear contemporary appearance.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The soft neutral palette, smooth surfaces and clean geometric forms create a feeling of ease, clarity and quiet calm — a space where the mind can rest.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Premium materials, statement furniture, rich textures, bespoke details and elegant layered lighting create sophisticated formal living and dining spaces. The atmosphere feels luxurious and refined without excessive ornamentation.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The rich material palette, layered lighting and refined forms create a feeling of quiet confidence — a space that feels special without ever being loud.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Rich timber, carved woodwork, brass accents, traditional furniture and natural materials create warm spaces inspired by Kerala heritage. The design feels culturally rooted, handcrafted and welcoming.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The warm timber tones, glowing brass and rounded forms create a feeling of belonging, tradition and heartfelt comfort.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Symmetrical planning, light colours, refined wall mouldings, elegant furniture and restrained classical ornamentation create graceful and timeless spaces. It offers a formal character with a lighter contemporary feel.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The light palette, symmetry and delicate details create a feeling of grace, order and quiet sophistication.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: High ceilings, arched openings, dark timber, cane details, patterned flooring and tropical features create dignified yet comfortable living and dining spaces. The style suits spacious, climate-responsive homes.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The airy volumes, natural textures and tropical elements create a feeling of timeless ease and relaxed elegance.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Soft colours, natural timber, comfortable upholstered furniture, floral or checked fabrics and familiar decorative details create warm and welcoming spaces. The atmosphere feels relaxed, homely and elegant.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The gentle colours, soft fabrics and familiar details create a feeling of homely warmth and everyday comfort.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Decorative wall panelling, marble, brass accents, refined furniture and sophisticated lighting create graceful formal interiors. The style brings elegant European character to both entertaining and dining areas.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The graceful details, soft palette and refined textures create a feeling of timeless romance and quiet sophistication.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Sleek furniture, dramatic stone, premium materials, refined proportions and carefully controlled lighting create understated luxury. The spaces feel modern, polished and visually well composed.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The refined materials and clean proportions create a feeling of effortless luxury and confident calm.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Textured walls, earthy colours, arches, rustic timber, natural stone and handmade finishes create warm and relaxed spaces. The design feels sunlit, informal and connected to outdoor living.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The sunny tones, natural textures and organic shapes create a feeling of warmth, relaxation and easy holiday living.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Dark timber, arched details, patterned tiles, wrought-iron accents and warm earthy colours create bold and character-rich interiors. The atmosphere feels handcrafted, intimate and inviting.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The rich textures, warm colours and handcrafted details create a feeling of intimacy, passion and old-world charm.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Pale timber, light colours, simple furniture, natural light and minimal decoration create bright and practical spaces. The style supports comfort, functionality and an easy, uncluttered lifestyle.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The light palette, natural materials and simple forms create a feeling of freshness, balance and everyday happiness.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Japanese simplicity combined with Scandinavian warmth creates calm and balanced living and dining spaces. Natural materials, low-profile furniture and muted colours promote a peaceful atmosphere.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The calm palette, natural textures and minimal details create a feeling of peace, grounding and quiet contentment.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Bold geometry, rich colours, metallic accents, luxurious fabrics and statement lighting create glamorous and memorable formal spaces. The style is dramatic, decorative and perfect for those who love a strong visual identity.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The deep colours, golden accents and dramatic forms create a feeling of glamour, confidence and celebration — a space that truly stands out.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Exposed brick or concrete, dark metal, timber, leather furniture and visible structural details create bold urban interiors. Warm lighting and comfortable furnishings help balance the raw material character.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The raw textures, warm lights and honest materials create a feeling of strength, character and relaxed confidence — urban yet welcoming.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Natural timber, stone, earthy colours, textured fabrics and handcrafted furniture create warm and grounded spaces. The design has a relaxed atmosphere and a strong connection to nature.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The earthy materials, natural textures and handmade details create a feeling of warmth, comfort and belonging — close to nature, close to home.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Natural materials, greenery, wide openings, relaxed furniture and strong indoor-outdoor connections create fresh and breathable living and dining spaces. The style is perfectly suited to tropical climates and relaxed lifestyles.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The greenery, natural textures and open connections create a feeling of freshness, freedom and everyday escape.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Sculptural furniture, advanced technology, bold forms, integrated lighting and unconventional materials create innovative and immersive interiors. The spaces feel sleek, experimental and forward-looking.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The flowing forms, integrated lights and innovative details create a feeling of wonder, excitement and the joy of the future.

formal_living_dining.designBrief: Two or more styles are thoughtfully combined to create a personalised design — for example, traditional woodwork with modern furniture, lighting and planning. The combination is carefully balanced to maintain visual harmony across spaces.
formal_living_dining.howItFeels: The blend of familiar warmth and modern ease creates a feeling of personal identity, comfort and timeless relevance.
